observations.title: All advisories appear to target dev-only build tooling in a project that ships pre-built dist
observations.technical_explanation: The lockfile shows a single runtime dependency (sillytavern-utils-lib) and all visible packages are dev or peer dependencies for the webpack, typescript, and babel build chain. The README confirms that dist is committed to the repository so users do not run a local build. The eight OSV-scanner advisories had package details removed, preventing exact mapping, but the project structure strongly suggests all flagged packages are build-time tools with no runtime reachability for end users who install the pre-built extension. Confidence is low because the truncated lockfile context and removed package details prevent confirming which specific packages each advisory targets.
observations.layman_explanation: All eight scanner flags point to dependencies that are most likely build tools. Since this extension ships ready-to-use files and users do not run a build, these tools never execute on users' machines. The flags are worth addressing for developer hygiene but do not indicate danger to extension users.
observations.developer_action: Run a dependency update pass on devDependencies to clear known advisories from the build environment. No urgent action is needed for the shipped extension.
